# v0.6.0 — Charging targets, estimates and easier app setup

Stable release for the integration and optional Modbus app.

- **Charging targets:** limit a charge by additional kWh or an optional vehicle
  percentage from an existing SoC sensor. Setting a target never starts charging
  or lifts a deliberate pause.
- **Losses and costs:** optional estimates from BavarianData history or a vehicle
  energy sensor, plus fixed or dynamic electricity prices and optional network tariffs.
- **Clearer controls:** charging status, connection quality, cancellable queued
  changes and optional command-result events for automations.
- **Charging waits:** configurable intervals, visible pending actions and
  vehicle-confirmed pauses before phase changes.
- **Easier app setup:** a USB adapter dropdown and separate LAN fields. Missing
  old USB devices no longer prevent saving LAN settings.
- **Reliability and maintenance:** improved heartbeat/reconnect recovery, AppArmor
  protection, clearer icons and grouping, and quieter Recorder defaults.

## Update

Update the app to **0.6.0 first** to use all new service features, then update the
integration and restart Home Assistant Core. Keep the existing app data and HA
entry. Both **`#apps` and `#apps-beta`** receive the stable app; beta users can
update normally without reinstalling or switching catalogs. An app restart
briefly interrupts heartbeat and cancels pending commands.

The integration still supports **HA 2026.9+** and compatible **API 2 services from
0.5.0**. New service capabilities need app **0.6.0**. Its **Open Web UI** connection
page requires an administrator and stable **Supervisor 2026.11.0+**; native
configuration remains available.
